title: College Admissions Process Roadmap
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: An interactive road map of the six stages of the college admissions process, with a drag-and-drop quiz on their order.

learningObjectives: Students will identify the six stages of the college admissions process in order and recall roughly when each one happens in senior year.
prerequisites: Chapter 1: The College Landscape and Application Rounds

keyQuestions: Which stages overlap in time? What does that mean for your fall schedule?
Why does Build Your List come before Apply, even though some applications open in August?
Which stage happens after you're admitted, and what is its key deadline?
commonMisconceptions: Financial aid starts only after you're admitted; in fact the FAFSA opens in the fall while you are still applying.
assessmentOpportunities: Students place all six tiles correctly in quiz mode and can name the month of the national commitment deadline (May 1).
